purpose_context: Today the analyzer's version is a hardcoded Go constant that must be manually bumped to match each release tag, and shipped binaries carry no commit or build-date provenance. This mission injects version, commit SHA, and build date at release-build time via linker flags and surfaces them as a structured build object in the version command and report JSON, so every binary is traceable to the commit that produced it and no release ships a mismatched version again. Closes issues #19 and #21.
purpose_tldr: Binaries report their real version, commit, and build date from the release build instead of a hand-edited constant.
